gap: The invariant is not merely unproven but violated: consumers of balances read a store that is neither the ledger nor derived from it. The agent desk reads a Portfolio frozen at initial equity with no positions while the risk monitor reads TrackedCapital -- the rationale's own failure ('two stores that both claim authority over a balance will disagree, and whichever one a consumer happens to read decides what the platform believes it owns'). Desk fills and cell fills land in different books (TrackedCapital vs UserLedger), so no single store holds the platform's cash. No architecture test enumerates cash/position/obligation writers.
